compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: God announces restored fortunes, mercy, gathering, secure dwelling, acknowledged judgment, no one left among the nations, an uncovered face, and Spirit poured on Israel.
observations.label: Gathered Israel is promised an outpoured Spirit

observations.body: The passage presents Gathering and restoring as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Gathering and restoring

observations.body: The passage places House of Israel beside Gathering and restoring.
observations.label: House of Israel

payload.posture: Read Ezekiel 39:25–29 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states god announces restored fortunes, mercy, gathering, secure dwelling, acknowledged judgment, no one left among the nations, an uncovered face, and Spirit poured on Israel. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: Gathered Israel is promised an outpoured Spirit
